name: minimal-component-catalog-cards
goal: Component catalog cards show their title, screenshot and Used In links only at desktop, tablet and phone widths, with no summary, contents, status, verification or open action

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: At the main Components catalog, TitleList currently shows its revision-bound image and name plus a summary, Contains list, status badge, verification mark and Open component control; acceptance is image, title and Used In module links only.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing standardized catalog E2E coverage in harness-explorer-catalog.spec.ts exercises search/navigation but not component-card contents; harness-explorer-evidence.spec.ts covers component detail and owned screenshots. Extend the catalog scenario with the seeded TitleList consumer at desktop, tablet and mobile widths, and assert the unwanted card content is absent.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Harness loop record red failed on committed test e7fead75d74853f515dc7cdbf7792006cb4df9c7. The unchanged catalog E2E at desktop, tablet and mobile received 1 for the forbidden Contains label; checkpoint screenshots were captured before the assertions.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Opus 5.5 reduced component cards to their own screenshot or existing gap, linked title, and revision-scoped Used In links. Removed summary, Contains, badges, verification, provenance caption and redundant action; kept page cards unchanged. Updated the shared card-grid comment and removed its dead action style, with related reports tests following the title link and hiding source copy.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
